stem:
Krish opens the valve on a bicycle tyre. The air pressure inside the tyre is higher than the air pressure outside, and the open valve connects the two regions.

What happens to the air?

options.text: Air flows from inside the tyre to outside until the pressures are almost equal.
The open valve itself is the high-pressure region that forces air into the tyre.
Air flows out even if the valve stays fully closed and no path connects the regions.
Air flows from the lower outside pressure into the higher-pressure tyre.

teacher.key_rationale: Air flows from higher pressure inside the tyre to lower pressure outside through the open path until the pressures nearly equalise.
